the development and testing of a new instrument to measure physical activity.
the development of a questionnaire that can be administered over the telephone and that can be used to measure physical activity in a population-based sample.
the development, evaluation and implementation of a telephone version of the 7-Day Physical Activity Recall (PAR).

the telephone and in person interview versions of the Physical Activity Recall (PAR) are both valid and reliable.
the telephone interview version of the PAR is valid and reliable for use in the measurement of physical activity in the elderly population.
the telephone version of the PAR-7 is valid for the assessment of PA in older adults.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the PAR is really a valid and reliable instrument for assessing physical activity in the general population.
